tokens.name: equinet-color-navy
tokens.usage: Navigation button fill; card left border; focus rings on light grounds. White label on it measures 10.5:1.

tokens.name: equinet-color-navy--dark
tokens.usage: Navigation button hover fill. White label on it measures 15.2:1.

tokens.name: equinet-color-orange
tokens.usage: Primary button fill; kicker and eyebrow text; textual button arrow on hover. White label on it measures 3.4:1 and does not meet AA at 16px — accepted by the client 2026-09-21.

tokens.name: equinet-color-orange--light
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill on dark grounds; navigation button hover label. White label on it measures 2.5:1 and does not meet AA at any size — part of the accepted exception.

tokens.name: equinet-color-orange--dark
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill on light grounds. White label on it measures 4.4:1, marginally short of AA at 16px — part of the accepted exception.

tokens.name: equinet-color-orange--pale
tokens.usage: Eyebrow pill background. Orange text on it measures 2.9:1 and does not meet AA — unresolved, flagged for review. Also covers #FFE6DB, seen across 3 marketing files (7 occurrences) and folded into this token 2026-09-23 rather than kept separate.

tokens.name: equinet-color-heading
tokens.usage: Heading fill on light surfaces. 15.0:1 on white. Visually identical to equinet-color-text; kept separate because the two trace to distinct Figma fills.

tokens.name: equinet-color-text
tokens.usage: Textual button label and UI text on light surfaces. 15.0:1 on white.

tokens.name: equinet-color-body
tokens.usage: Body copy and card descriptions. 10.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: equinet-color-black
tokens.usage: Card headings where the comp specifies true black rather than the heading grey.

tokens.name: equinet-color-border
tokens.usage: One-pixel rules and dividers under stat rows. Non-text; not held to the 4.5:1 threshold.

tokens.name: equinet-color-surface
tokens.usage: Page and card surface; label colour on every filled button.

tokens.name: equinet-color-surface--alt
tokens.usage: End stop of the module background gradient, paired with equinet-color-surface. Note: a published infographic uses #ECEAEA for a similar panel background — close but not identical; unresolved whether that's deliberate or drift.

tokens.name: equinet-color-chart-blue-light
tokens.usage: Chart/data-viz gradient, lightest stop. Sourced from a published marketing infographic, not a shipped module. Not for UI, buttons, or text — distinct from equinet-color-navy by design.

tokens.name: equinet-color-chart-blue-mid
tokens.usage: Chart/data-viz gradient, middle stop.

tokens.name: equinet-color-chart-blue-dark
tokens.usage: Chart/data-viz gradient, darkest stop.

tokens.name: equinet-color-diagram-line
tokens.usage: Illustration line/icon colour in marketing diagrams, used as both fill and stroke. Confirmed in all 7 files of a marketing-collateral batch. Not for UI or module text.

tokens.name: equinet-color-diagram-line--neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral-grey variant of diagram-line, no blue cast. Confirmed fill+stroke across 5 of 17 marketing files audited to date. Not for UI or module text.

tokens.name: equinet-color-diagram-tint
tokens.usage: Light panel/shape tint in marketing diagrams. Confirmed in 3 of 7 files in the same batch.

tokens.name: equinet-color-diagram-tint--pale
tokens.usage: Palest background tint in marketing diagrams. Confirmed in all 7 files of the same batch. A cluster of three near-white values remains unresolved: #ECEAEA and #F3F2F2 (both in the ABM infographic) and #F3F3F4 (The-Brand-Ops-Agent) are each close to but not identical to this token or to each other.
